scenario: The ego vehicle waits at an intersection while an adversarial vehicle drives straight across from left to right.

ego.behavior: The car remains stationary at the intersection.

adversarials.behavior: The car drives straight across the intersection from left to right.

spatial_relation: At a four-way intersection, the ego vehicle is positioned in the center of the intersection facing north, while the adversarial vehicle approaches from the left (west) and travels eastward across the intersection.
requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must remain stationary at the intersection while the adversarial vehicle crosses; the scenario terminates once the adversarial vehicle has cleared the intersection.
reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: The blue car is ego (labeled and centered); the pink car is adversarial. 2. Enumeration: one adversarial car. 3. Chronology: Initially ego is stationary at intersection; adversarial approaches from left. Midpoint adversarial enters and crosses intersection. Ending adversarial exits to the right. 4. Evidence: Ego's position unchanged across phases; adversarial's position shifts left to right through intersection.
